intro: Break a Few Eggs is an errand assisting a harried cook who must keep up with endless meal preparations. Securing fresh, fragile ingredients without breaking them keeps the kitchen running and the cooking on schedule.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Breakfast, lunch, dinner! Who cares which meal it is? It still has to be cooked by someone--namely me!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You might be weak, but at least you're not clumsy, friend.
Here, take this and get outta my way. I've got cooking to do.
